authorization: Owner reports free API-client setup complete; ordinary existing-client access only. No registration, commercial entitlement or economic pilot is performed by this task.

authentication.provenance: Official registration documentation already archived as original 005.
authentication.credentials: Read locally from ignored .env; never print, commit or place in URLs. Preserve token response privately; public receipts contain status/hash/count only.

selection_index.reason: This documented, read-only query endpoint is the available area/week index. Selection uses locality ID and historic licensing/geography only. Server responses also contain health summaries: retain and count those returned records explicitly, but do not use health fields for selection or analyse nonselected sites.
selection_index.frame: Keep the original rule: the three lowest IDs in each area, weeks 10/2021 and 10/2024. Freeze all twelve slots before detailed requests. Metadata-index rows outside this selected frame are not independent sample observations.

sampling_allocation.reason: The twelve-slot frame is a maximum. Preserve eight initially unvisited slots. Four detail-plus-visit pairs leave four ordinary starts for at most two weekly vessel tracks and two dated ownership evidence documents, or further already-framed slots if no vessel candidate exists. Do not replace quiet/missing sites or expand the frame.
sampling_allocation.vessel_selection: At most two lowest numeric MMSIs observed at two different frozen sites in the same week; if none are shared, inspect at most two lowest numeric wellboat MMSIs in the observed sample to check wider weekly visited-site evidence. No future visits define earlier eligibility.
sampling_allocation.vessel_track_scope: A selected vessel's one-week track can contain other visited sites. Count these as extra source context, not additional selected farm/treatment observations. Do not acquire extra farm histories to convert them into an expanded cohort.

terminal_rule: Return a completed bounded verification with all four gates and unknowns explicit. If distinctive task/sharing/prior-availability conditions cannot be established, do not authorize a full pilot, generic lice model or automatic backup.
